course_id: Quản trị năng suất và Tiêu chuẩn hóa
title: Management of Productivity and Standardization

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply principles of productivity management in various business contexts.
Apply lean management techniques to improve operational efficiency.
Implement Six Sigma methodologies to reduce process variation and enhance quality.
Utilize continuous improvement techniques to optimize processes and systems.
Develop effective time management strategies to increase personal productivity.
Enhance critical thinking abilities to solve complex problems efficiently.
Manage service productivity through measurement and improvement techniques.
